name: Helioform
summary: A build tracker for solar farm, battery storage and microgrid companies, with a live energy view
about: A business app for companies that build solar farms, battery storage and small power grids, and run many builds at once. It follows every project from development to operation with a phase schedule, supply orders, crews, a safety log and the output of finished plants, under a live hero where the sun crosses the sky and power flows to the batteries and the grid. Good for construction and energy firms, EPC contractors and developers.
how: Portfolio opens on the live energy view: the sun or moon moves with the time of day and power flows from the solar fleet to batteries and the grid every second.
Projects shows each build with its phase bar, risk and schedule slip. Open one for phases, orders, crews, files and notes, then move it to the next phase.
On Schedule, drag a phase to move it or drag its right edge to stretch it. Later phases are pushed so they never overlap.
On Supply, follow each order from Ordered to On site and press Advance as it moves. Late ones show in red.
On Crews, drag a crew card to another site or use its ⋯ menu. Safety counts the days since a lost-time injury and logs every report.
Output compares actual and expected generation with a 7D, 30D and 12M switch. Settings has the safety goal, live view, theme and Reset demo data.
